jobs.description_text: 在智能泊车项目中负责空间定位与局部建图算法的开发与量产落地，并主导解决量产过程中遇到的各类棘手长尾场景。 设计并实现高效的多传感器数据融合估计框架（包含不限于惯导 IMU、轮速计、视觉相机、激光雷达等数据），确保车辆在无 GPS 信号的地下车库、多层停车场等复杂环境里依然能精准感知自身位置。 针对资源受限的车载算力芯片进行深入的底层代码优化，在保证定位精度的同时，最小化内存和计算开销，提升算法的运行效率。 敏锐捕捉 SLAM、三维重建及多模态融合领域的前沿学术与行业动向，评估并推动先进技术在实际量产产品中的应用落地。 学历与专业：硕士及以上学历，计算机科学、车辆工程、数学、机器人学等相关专业。 工作经验：2年以上建图定位的开发经验。 理论基础：深刻理解 SLAM 技术链路（如图优化、状态估计等理论），熟悉常用的非线性优化库（如 Ceres、g2o、GTSAM） 编程能力：精通 C++ 编程，具备良好的代码风格和工程实践能力；同时熟悉 Python，能够用于快速原型验证和工具开发。 综合素质： 具备出色的逻辑思维能力、问题分析与解决能力，以及良好的沟通能力和团队协作精神 加分项： 拥有 AI 模型相关的学习背景或项目经验（例如：熟悉如何利用深度学习网络进行特征点提取/匹配、语义分割或端到端定位，熟悉 PyTorch 框架及 TensorRT 部署流程者尤佳）。 完整经历过至少一款 APA 自动泊车或 AVP 代客泊车等量产功能研发全周期的候选人优先

jobs.description_text: 一、岗位定位与使命 作为智能驾驶系统闭环的核心研发人员，负责设计、开发并量产先进的车辆运动控制算法（横向跟踪、纵向加减速、线控底盘协同），精准驱动转向、制动与动力系统执行规划路径。在确保极高系统安全性、鲁棒性与乘坐舒适性的同时，推动算法在实车平台及主流域控制器（如 Orin、Thor、地平线等）上的规模化落地。 二、核心岗位职责 1. 控制算法设计与开发 负责自动驾驶（L2+ 至 L4 级别）横向、纵向及横纵协同控制算法的方案设计与实现； 研发高精度轨迹跟踪算法，涵盖城市道路、高速场景（如 NOA/NGP）以及低速自主泊车（APA/AVP）场景； 针对复杂工况（如极限附着力、高速避障、颠簸路面、风阻扰动等），研发具备强抗干扰能力的自适应与鲁棒控制策略。 2. 车辆动力学建模与参数辨识 建立高保真度车辆动力学模型（包括双轨/单轨模型、非线性轮胎模型如 Pacejka 魔术公式、动力总成与制动系统传动延迟模型等）； 负责车辆底盘物理参数的在线与离线辨识，优化模型前馈与反馈补偿机制。 3. 仿真与虚拟验证 基于 CarMaker 等工具链构建高置信度的模型在环（MIL）与软件在环（SIL）仿真平台； 设计仿真用例与极端边缘工况（Edge Cases），开展系统稳定性、响应时间与舒适度指标评估。 4. 实车标定、调试与硬件在环（HIL） 参与台架测试（HIL）与实车动态调试，对接线控底盘（线控转向 SBW、线控制动 EMB/One-box 等）； 负责控制参数标定工作，持续优化车道居中精度、跟车平顺性、加减速 Jerk 值及乘坐舒适体验。 5. 工程化部署与量产交付 负责控制算法的 C/C++ 工程化实现； 适配嵌入式车载操作系统（QNX、Linux、RTOS）及 Classic/Adaptive AUTOSAR 架构，确保实时性与确定性调度； 配合功能安全工程师落实 ISO 26262 流程要求，完成故障注入、降级安全控制与失效保护策略设计。 三、任职资格要求 1. 教育背景与从业经验 学历要求 ：自动化、控制理论与控制工程、车辆工程、机械电子、计算机或应用数学等相关专业统招硕士及以上学历； 工作经验 ：3 年及以上智能驾驶或整车动力学控制算法研发经验，至少拥有一个完整的量产交付项目经验； 2. 专业理论与算法技能 扎实的现代控制理论基础，熟练掌握经典与现代控制算法，包括但不限于： 横向控制 ：PID、LQR、模型预测控制（MPC）、滑模控制（SMC）、纯跟踪（Pure Pursuit）、Stanley 等； 纵向控制 ：分层控制架构、速度/加速度前馈反馈控制、能量管理与再生制动协调； 深入理解汽车动力学理论（纵向/横向/垂向动力学），熟悉转向、悬架、驱动与制动执行机构的动力学响应特性与延迟。 3. 编程与工具链熟练度 熟练掌握 C/C++ 编程，具备良好的面向对象设计思想与代码规范（MISRA C/C++）； 熟悉 Linux 开发环境，熟练运用 Git、CANoe/CANalyzer 等总线测试工具，掌握 CAN/CAN-FD/车载以太网通信协议。 四、加分项（优先考虑） 量产经验丰富 ：有主流主机厂（OEM）或知名 Tier 1 的量产定点交付经验，熟悉整车 V 字型开发流程与 ASPICE 规范； 前沿技术研究 ：在控制与规划一体化、端到端学习控制（RL/Imitation Learning）、极端工况控制等领域有论文发表或技术储备； 线控底盘集成 ：具备制动（ESC/IBC）、转向（EPS/SBW）或主动悬架底层集成与调校经验； 功能安全 ：熟悉 ISO 26262 功能安全标准（具备 ASIL D 控制策略设计能力）或 SOTIF（预期功能安全

jobs.description_text: 岗位职责 需求与架构设计：负责整车纵向控制功能的客户需求分析，设计并持续优化车端业务逻辑与软件架构，输出功能需求与技术方案文档。 纵向控制算法开发：负责纵向控制算法（ PID、LQR、MPC 、前馈 + 反馈、抗饱和等）的设计、开发、优化与重构，制定算法 KPI （跟车误差、加速度 /Jerk 、制动平顺性、响应时间等），主导系统异常（如 coredump ）及复杂 Bug 的分析与修复。 底盘执行器协同：负责与底盘域（ ESP、VCU、EPS、PBM、EPB 等）握手协议制定与落地，主导执行器特性标定、非线性补偿（油门 / 制动踏板的驱动扭矩与制动扭矩接口），提升纵向执行精度与控制平顺性。 创新功能拓展：负责纵向控制场景下创新性功能的预研、开发与验证（能量回收协同、坡道控制、蠕行控制、舒适制动、驾驶风格自适应等），对标竞品并融合用户体验反馈，持续提升产品力。 实车调测与闭环：负责纵向控制功能的实车联调、性能测试、参数标定及问题分析定位，覆盖全速域跟车、启停、切入切出、坡道、紧急制动等典型工况，确保车端功能性能的高质量交付。 AI 驱动基建搭建：主导构建可持续开发的 Harness 工程框架（涵盖 MIL/SIL 、开闭环仿真等），为纵向控制算法的快速迭代与自动化验证提供支持。 研发智能体与 Skill 开发：搭建面向研发流程的 AI Agent 架构，开发智能体 Skill 插件，将代码生成、 Log 分析、仿真触发等工程动作封装为可调用工具，实现研发流程的自动化与智能化。 LLM 辅助开发：运用大语言模型（ LLM ）辅助编码与算法迭代，设计高质量的任务指令与上下文管理策略，提升代码产出效率。 工程文档规范化：编写并维护高质量技术文档与配置文件（ JSON/Markdown/HTML 等），沉淀开发知识、测试用例与提示词模板，提升团队协作效率。 任职资格 学历：硕士及以上学历，计算机、车辆工程、人工智能、电子信息、机械电子、通信工程、自动化控制等相关专业。 编程能力：精通 C/C++/Python 等编程语言，具备扎实的算法与数据结构基础；熟练掌握 JSON、Markdown 等数据或文本格式。 Harness 与仿真：具备从零搭建测试 Harness 工程框架的实战经验，精通自动驾驶仿真测试技术，熟练使用常用仿真工具及自动化测试脚本开发。 操作系统与中间件：精通 ROS 框架，具备 Linux 或 QNX 系统下的量产项目开发与调试经验。 软件架构：熟练掌握软件架构设计模式，具备丰富的智驾域控端应用软件开发经验，熟悉各类中间件，并有算力与系统资源优化经验。 纵向控制算法（核心）：熟悉多种控制接口（ Fx, Ax 等），精通纵向控制算法（ PID、LQR、MPC 、前馈 + 反馈、抗饱和、时变参数自适应、精通各种滤波算法应用调参等），深入理解其原理及优劣势，至少在 2 个量产或重点客户项目中成功应用上述算法，实现纵向控制功能（ APA/RPA 等）及性能提升。 横纵向耦合认知：熟悉常用横向控制算法（ MPC,LQR 等），理解横纵向控制解耦与协调，具备横纵向联合调参经验。 底盘执行器：熟悉低速 / 中高速底盘执行器（ ESP、VCU、EPS、PBM、EPB 、扭矩 / 制动 / 踏板接口等）特性及握手协议，具备执行器标定、非线性补偿与故障处理能力，具备跨模块协作与系统级优化能力。 感知定位：熟悉多传感器融合感知方案与车载 IMU、GPS 及多传感器融合定位技术；具备 APA/ACC/AEB 等纵向控制量产项目经验者优先。 趋势洞察：洞察纵向控制领域算法发展趋势，具备新算法预研与落地能力。 大模型辅助编程：熟练掌握大模型辅助编程技巧（如 Vibe Coding ），精通提示词与上下文工程；精通 Harness 工程，必须能通过严格的自动化验证闭环，确保 AI 辅助生成的代码符合车规级量产标准。 AI Agent 能力：具备独立搭建研发效能类 AI Agent 的能力，精通 Skill 开发（将工程工具与流程封装为 Agent 可调用的技能插件），熟练掌握 MCP 协议；有利用大语言模型（ LLM ）加速 ADAS 领域内代码开发、测试或问题分析的经验者优先。

jobs.description_text: 工作职责： 负责自动泊车（APA / RPA / AVP）感知算法研发与量产落地，聚焦 Freespace、Occupancy（OCC）占用感知，构建车库场景空间占据表示； 基于图像、点云、多相机 BEV 架构开发占用网络、可行驶区域、空车位空间检测，输出稠密空间占据、占用流、障碍物体素表示； 负责多传感器（摄像头、超声、毫米波雷达）与 OCC / Freespace 的融合，解决地下车库弱光、反光、遮挡、异形车位、低矮障碍物等难点； 参与端到端泊车感知 / 规划联合方案调研、预研与验证； 搭建泊车场景 OCC / Freespace 数据集，设计标注、数据筛选、仿真增广、自动评测体系；完成模型训练、损失设计、后处理、量化压缩与车载部署； 实车调试，基于日志、点云、图像、标定数据定位召回、误报、时序漂移问题，持续提升稠密感知的精度、时延与鲁棒性； 和规划、控制、测试、标定团队对齐感知输出接口、指标体系（占用准确率、空区域召回、边缘精度等），推动算法迭代交付； 跟踪 BEV、Occupancy、Sparse / Dense 占用、端到端自动驾驶感知前沿，评估新技术在泊车场景的落地价值。 任职要求： 硕士及以上，计算机、自动化、电子信息、模式识别等相关专业； 扎实的计算机视觉、深度学习基础，熟悉相机成像、多视几何、BEV、Transformer、体素 / 栅格表示； 有 Freespace 或 Occupancy / OCC 算法开发经验优先，有稠密占用网络、可行驶区域分割项目经验； 熟练 PyTorch，C++ / Python，熟悉 OpenCV、PCL；了解 ONNX、TensorRT、模型量化、车载 SOC 部署； 熟悉车载传感器特性，做多相机标定、时 空同步、传感器融合；有泊车场景（地下车库、室内）感知经验加分； 能独立分析实车日志、构建评测指标，对稠密感知的误差来源有较强定位能力； 良好工程素养，有量产交付意识，熟悉算法从训练、仿真到实车验证全流程。

At least 2 years experiences in motor control. Solid basic knowledge of control theory, e.g. automatic control theory, modern control theory and application, linear control theory, nonlinear control theory etc. 至少两年以上电机控制开发经验, 熟悉掌握基本的控制理论知识，如自动控制原理、现代控制理论、线性控制理论和非线性控制理论等 3. Strong technical knowledge in electromagnetic principle of different kinds of motors as BLDC motor, PMSM, Synchronous reluctance motor, switched reluctance motor etc. 深入理解各种电机的电磁工作原理，如无刷直流电机、永磁同步电机、同步磁阻电机、异步电机和开关磁阻等 4. Proficiency in motor control, such as six-step square control, field oriented control, direct torque control, flux weaken control, sensorless control as observer and high frequency injection method, energy optimized control, fault diagnosis and protection and so on. 精通电机控制算法，如六步方波控制，矢量控制，直接转矩控制，弱磁控制，无传感器控制如观测器和高频注入法，系统最优效率控制等，故障诊断与保护等 5. jobs.description_text:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

Flexport is a platform for global trade in an industry that comprises 12% of the global GDP. We are the first licensed freight forwarder and customs brokerage built around a modern tech stack. We help the world's fastest-growing brands manage their international supply chains, providing a fully-managed service for moving products between any two places on the planet.

Exceptional software development is integral in allowing us to fulfill our mission of fixing the user experience in global trade. At Flexport you’ll develop products that are at the forefront of reshaping the entire logistics & supply chain industries. You’ll work alongside self-starters interested in solving real-world problems and streamlining the inefficiencies in the complex global trade industry. You’ll have the opportunity to reshape an industry by creating the new operating system for global trade.

Our engineers are top-notch software developers who love listening to the users, working as a team, and proactively taking the lead whenever necessary. The role involves learning the business of freight forwarding, modeling the work that people do to move freight, designing solutions to make it more efficient, and thinking innovatively to automate much of it. As a full stack Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, designing, developing, testing and maintaining critical forwarding related systems. In addition, as the team lead, you are expected to mentor other engineers and lead them deliver high quality results that meet customer expectations.

About the team:

We have multiple teams in Shanghai and Shenzhen working on a suite of core products and services that enable Flexport business to scale, including Freight Services Planning, Procurement, Commerce, Security and Infrastructure, Visibility and Schedules, and so on. We are broadly leveraging optimization models, machine learning (ML) and natural language processing (NLP) to build the best solutions for our customers. We are looking for engineers who love learning, are passionate about collaborating, and desire to build solutions with a global impact.

You will:

  • Build highly available, secure, distributed systems in a microservice architecture.
  • Design, develop, test and maintain systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities, such as shipper, client, cargo, document, carrier, container, email etc.
  • Collaborate with some of the best engineers in the industry to work on complex business and technical problems.
  • Architect and drive major projects while coordinating with multiple stakeholders. We often work on multi-month projects that require phased rollouts and collaboration with cross-functional team members.
  • Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.
  • Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.
  • You play a significant role in the career development of others, actively mentoring and educating the larger software engineering community on trends, technologies, and best practices.
  • Ensure our products maintain a high-quality bar. We believe in anticipating issues by obsessing over metrics and applying key learnings from post-mortems to all our services.
  • Tackle difficult and subtle system-level issues, emphasizing simplicity and long-lasting designs. As we extract services out of the monolith, we take pride in untangling legacy code and re-building with composability in mind.
  • Geek out about shipping and logistics. (We do this often.)

You should have:

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.
  • 3+ years of design and architecture knowledge as well as familiarity with object-oriented analysis and design patterns (OOA/OOD)
  • Experience of building large scale, high-performance systems in a complex, multi-tiered, distributed environment.
  • Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, Kotlin, Ruby, Python or C++.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
  • A bias for action. When you see a problem, you solve it.
  • The ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business partners, product managers, and engineers alike.
  • Experience of effectively and reliably delivering large projects involving multi teams/orgs, including breaking the projects down into smaller pieces, cooperating with dependent teams to align on critical technical decisions, driving conversation regards long term strategy and delivering the right result in high standard.
  • Understanding of performance tradeoffs, load balancing and operational issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor junior software engineers in all aspects of their engineering skill-sets.
  • Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operations.
  • Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

Flexport is looking for a creative, technically-minded Senior Data Scientist who is excited about solving challenging problems in fulfillment and logistics. We provide ecommerce merchants a full range of "factory to door" logistics solutions. This role focuses on building automated decision-making processes that ensure that we meet or exceed the expectations of our merchants for fulfillment speed and reliability, while growing the network in a cost-efficient way.

Data is at the heart of our business, and as a Data Scientist, you will develop first-in-class science products to make fulfillment easy and efficient for our merchants. In collaboration with multidisciplinary product, engineering, and business/operations teams, you will apply advanced Operations Research (OR) and Machine Learning (ML) methods to deliver data-driven insights and automated decision-making solutions in Flexport’s fulfillment products.

Our business, product, and engineering teams collaborate closely with our Data Scientists to share domain knowledge, test hypotheses at scale, and develop promising solutions that can be quickly and widely deployed. We are passionate about providing effortlessly accessible intelligence and actionable insights to our end users. Our ideal candidate is: self-motivated, technically excellent at writing code, and passionate about delivering cutting-edge solutions.

You will:

  • Design and develop models and algorithms to enable and improve the service of the fulfillment network, including optimal inventory management and reliable delivery service
  • Collaborate with business/product team the goal to reduce fulfillment network variable cost reduction by identifying the cost saving opportunities and figuring out proper solution
  • Contribute to projects that measurably impact business goals, translating a business need to an actionable development plan and executing the plan successfully
  • Work cross functionally across Data Science, Engineering, Product, Planning and Operations to implement production processes and reporting to achieve desired KPIs
  • Contribute to data science and analytics best practices for the team and across the organization

You should have:

  • A degree in a quantitative field like Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Econometrics, etc.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in solving optimization and/or machine learning problems and developing practically efficient, automated solutions
  • Experience developing, enhancing, and maintaining end-to-end data science production processes, including data modeling, algorithm development, testing, and metric tracking
  • Software engineering experience to build software to solve real industrial problems, with a strong understanding of system architecture
  • Proficient with frontier AI models to proactively identify the opportunities for business growth and operational cost saving
  • Proficient with Python and SQL. Experience with Snowflake, dbt, data visualization/reporting tools (e.g. Looker) preferred
  • A "compliance first" attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.
